purpose: Teach: 澆/椶/僂/彡/シーク/同省/未確認/西方

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、農業用の澆水、つまり澆灌設備の盗難を、警察、捜査されますね
lines.en: So the police will be investigating this case of agricultural irrigation equipment theft, correct?
lines.style: Measured, slightly formal. Ren is asking for confirmation with genuine curiosity. Steady pacing, almost rhythmic. Respectful distance maintained.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、希少植物椶、つまり椶櫚の密採事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police will also be handling the case of illegally poached rare palm plants, I understand?
lines.style: Calm affirmation. Officer Takeda is confirming Ren's understanding. Professional but warm. Clear enunciation. Slight nod implied in the voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、長時間の僂佝、つまり僂姿勢関連の労災を、警察、調査されますね
lines.en: So the police will be investigating this case involving work-related injury claims from prolonged poor posture, right?
lines.style: Thoughtful and careful. Ren is picking up the pattern, asking another clarifying question. Slightly slower pace. Respectful tone, almost deferential.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、書道家の彡、つまり彡偏の偽造書画も鑑定されますね
lines.en: And the police will also be authenticating forged calligraphy and artwork, I take it?
lines.style: Steady acknowledgment. Officer Takeda continues the pattern with professional ease. Unhurried delivery. Warm but official tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、シーク教徒、つまりシーク派の宗教施設の警備を、警察、強化されますね
lines.en: So the police will be strengthening security at Sikh religious facilities in this case as well, correct?
lines.style: Careful and respectful. Ren's questions are becoming more specific. Even pacing. Genuinely seeking confirmation, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、同省、つまり同省の関連機関とも連携されますね
lines.en: And the police will be coordinating with related agencies, I understand?
lines.style: Light, affirming. Officer Takeda confirms the broader institutional coordination. Professional, with a touch of reassurance. Clear and concise.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、未確認の不審物の通報を、警察、慎重に対応されますね
lines.en: So the police will be handling reports of unidentified suspicious objects with appropriate caution in this case?
lines.style: Deliberate and careful. Ren wants to understand how the police are managing public reports. Even tone. Slight emphasis on 'appropriate caution'.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、西方諸国、つまり西方からの密航事案も対応されますね
lines.en: And the police will also be addressing human trafficking cases from western countries, I assume?
lines.style: Steady closing question. Officer Takeda wraps up the checklist with professional finality. Direct eye-contact level delivery. Concluding tone.
